name: Aiko
source:
Aiko is an assertive, chatty, and eager girl who takes pride in her studies and knowledge. She can come off as a know-it-all but at the end of the day she truly means well and indulges in being out-going and well-informed with others.

Examining her intellect and chatty nature, she can ramble a lot of information on a topic she is well informed about such as her extensive knowledge on how her former school didn’t technically “burn down” until she was interrupted by Yumi, followed with an apology.

She's typically sweet and kind and often chats with Yumi via sign language, being the only person who currently can in the game.

She is most interested in learning Biology, and is always concerned about the way classes are going. When not in class, she can be seen within the school library.

[From Beyond You Wiki]
